def factor_overnight_intraday_cycle_tstat(df):
    """EMA-smoothed overnight minus intraday divergence normalized by trailing volatility, a moving t-stat."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    diff = overnight_ret - intraday_ret
    smooth_diff = diff.ewm(span=60, min_periods=1).mean()
    vol = diff.rolling(120, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    factor = (smooth_diff / vol).fillna(0.0)
    df_copy["factor_overnight_intraday_cycle_tstat"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_overnight_intraday_cycle_tstat"]
description: Mutation of parent overnight-intraday cycle dominance. Parent normalizes the EMA-smoothed overnight-minus-intraday divergence by the trailing sum of absolute overnight and intraday moves over 120 days. That denominator gives equal weight to stale observations and can be dominated by old large moves, contributing to amplitude sensitivity and limiting level IC/RankIC. This child preserves the same core economic mechanism and EMA span but divides by the trailing rolling standard deviation of the divergence instead, producing a moving t-stat that adapts to recent volatility. The change targets improved IC/RankIC while retaining the parent's ICIR/RankICIR stability and payoff thickness. Cross-sectional transform remains none because the raw divergence mechanism is preserved.
